addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

8	**Obsidian-style Live Preview for CodeMirror 6** — A modular plugin collection that hides Markdown syntax when you're not editing it.
9	
10	English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

12	[Live Demo](https://codemirror-live-markdown.vercel.app/) · [Documentation](#documentation) · [Roadmap](./ROADMAP.md)

14	---
15	
16	## Why This Library?
17	
18	Most Markdown editors force you to choose: either see raw syntax or rendered output. Live Preview gives you both — syntax fades in only when your cursor enters, letting you edit naturally while seeing formatted results.
19	
20	**Key differentiators:**
21	- **Modular** — Import only what you need (math? tables? code blocks?)
22	- **Zero lock-in** — Works with any CodeMirror 6 setup
23	- **Lightweight** — No heavy dependencies forced on you
24	
25	## Features
26	
27	| Feature | Description | Since |
28	|---------|-------------|-------|
29	| ✨ Live Preview | Hide markers when not editing | v0.1.0 |
30	| 📝 Inline Formatting | Bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code | v0.1.0 |
31	| 📑 Block Elements | Headers, lists, blockquotes | v0.1.0 |
32	| 🧮 Math | KaTeX rendering (inline & block) | v0.2.0 |
33	| 📊 Tables | GFM table rendering | v0.3.0 |
34	| 💻 Code Blocks | Syntax highlighting via lowlight | v0.4.0 |
35	| 🖼️ Images | Image preview with loading states | v0.5.0 |
36	| 🔗 Links | Clickable link rendering | v0.5.0 |
37	| 🧩 Editable Tables (Advanced) | Optional table editor with inline cells + source toggle | v0.5.1 |
38	
39	## Installation
40	
41	```bash
42	npm install codemirror-live-markdown
43	```
44	
45	**Peer dependencies:**
46	```bash
47	npm install @codemirror/state @codemirror/view @codemirror/lang-markdown @codemirror/language @lezer/markdown
48	```
49	
50	**Optional dependencies** (install only what you need):
51	```bash
52	npm install katex      # For math formulas
53	npm install lowlight   # For code syntax highlighting
54	```
55	
56	## Quick Start
57	
58	```typescript
59	import { EditorState } from '@codemirror/state';
60	import { EditorView } from '@codemirror/view';
61	import { markdown } from '@codemirror/lang-markdown';
62	import {
63	  livePreviewPlugin,
64	  markdownStylePlugin,
65	  editorTheme,
66	  mouseSelectingField,
67	  collapseOnSelectionFacet,
68	  setMouseSelecting,
69	} from 'codemirror-live-markdown';
70	
71	const view = new EditorView({
72	  state: EditorState.create({
73	    doc: '# Hello World\n\nThis is **bold** and *italic* text.',
74	    extensions: [
75	      markdown(),
76	      collapseOnSelectionFacet.of(true),
77	      mouseSelectingField,
78	      livePreviewPlugin,
79	      markdownStylePlugin,
80	      editorTheme,
81	    ],
82	  }),
83	  parent: document.getElementById('editor')!,
84	});
85	
86	// Required: Track mouse selection state
87	view.contentDOM.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
88	  view.dispatch({ effects: setMouseSelecting.of(true) });
89	});
90	document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
91	  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
92	    view.dispatch({ effects: setMouseSelecting.of(false) });
93	  });
94	});
95	```
96	
97	## Documentation
98	
99	### Adding Optional Features
100	
101	Each feature is a separate plugin. Import and add only what you need:
102	
103	```typescript
104	import { Table } from '@lezer/markdown';
105	import {
106	  mathPlugin,
107	  blockMathField,
108	  tableField,
109	  tableEditorPlugin,
110	  codeBlockField,
111	  codeBlockEditorPlugin,
112	  imageField,
113	  linkPlugin,
114	} from 'codemirror-live-markdown';
115	
116	const extensions = [
117	  markdown({ extensions: [Table] }), // Enable GFM tables in parser
118	  // ... core extensions from Quick Start
119	  
120	  // Optional features:
121	  mathPlugin,                        // Inline math: `$E=mc^2$`
122	  blockMathField,                    // Block math: ```math
123	  tableField,                        // GFM tables
124	  tableEditorPlugin(),               // Editable tables with source toggle
125	  codeBlockField({ copyButton: true }), // Code blocks with syntax highlighting
126	  codeBlockEditorPlugin({ copyButton: true }), // Code blocks with MD/Code toggle
127	  imageField(),                      // Image preview
128	  linkPlugin(),                      // Link rendering
129	];
130	```
131	
132	### Code Block Options
133	
134	```typescript
135	codeBlockField({
136	  lineNumbers: false,      // Show line numbers
137	  copyButton: true,        // Show copy button
138	  defaultLanguage: 'text', // Fallback language
139	  interaction: 'auto',     // 'auto' | 'toggle'
140	})
141	```
142	
143	- `interaction: 'auto'` (default): enter source mode when cursor enters code block.
144	- `interaction: 'toggle'`: keep rendered mode by default and switch with `MD` / `Code` buttons.
145	
146	### Code Block Editor Plugin
147	
148	```typescript
149	codeBlockEditorPlugin({
150	  copyButton: true,
151	  lineNumbers: false,
152	  defaultLanguage: 'text',
153	})
154	```
155	
156	`codeBlockEditorPlugin()` is a non-breaking convenience API for `codeBlockField({ interaction: 'toggle' })`.
157	
158	### Registering Additional Languages
159	
160	```typescript
161	import { registerLanguage, initHighlighter } from 'codemirror-live-markdown';
162	import rust from 'highlight.js/lib/languages/rust';
163	
164	// Initialize highlighter (required before first use)
165	await initHighlighter();
166	
167	// Register additional languages
168	registerLanguage('rust', rust);
169	```
170	
171	### Theming
172	
173	Customize with CSS variables:
174	
175	```css
176	:root {
177	  --md-heading: #1a1a1a;
178	  --md-bold: #1a1a1a;
179	  --md-italic: #1a1a1a;
180	  --md-link: #2563eb;
181	  --md-code-bg: #f5f5f5;
182	}
183	```
184	
185	## API Reference

188	
189	| Export | Description |

191	| `livePreviewPlugin` | Main live preview behavior |
192	| `markdownStylePlugin` | Styling for headers, bold, italic, etc. |
193	| `editorTheme` | Default theme with animations |

# codemirror-live-markdown

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/codemirror-live-markdown.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/codemirror-live-markdown)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/codemirror-live-markdown.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/codemirror-live-markdown)
[![CI](https://github.com/blueberrycongee/codemirror-live-markdown/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/blueberrycongee/codemirror-live-markdown/actions)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

**Obsidian-style Live Preview for CodeMirror 6** — A modular plugin collection that hides Markdown syntax when you're not editing it.

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

[Live Demo](https://codemirror-live-markdown.vercel.app/) · [Documentation](#documentation) · [Roadmap](./ROADMAP.md)

---

## Why This Library?

Most Markdown editors force you to choose: either see raw syntax or rendered output. Live Preview gives you both — syntax fades in only when your cursor enters, letting you edit naturally while seeing formatted results.

**Key differentiators:**
- **Modular** — Import only what you need (math? tables? code blocks?)
- **Zero lock-in** — Works with any CodeMirror 6 setup
- **Lightweight** — No heavy dependencies forced on you

## Features

| Feature | Description | Since |
|---------|-------------|-------|
| ✨ Live Preview | Hide markers when not editing | v0.1.0 |
| 📝 Inline Formatting | Bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code | v0.1.0 |
| 📑 Block Elements | Headers, lists, blockquotes | v0.1.0 |
| 🧮 Math | KaTeX rendering (inline & block) | v0.2.0 |
| 📊 Tables | GFM table rendering | v0.3.0 |
| 💻 Code Blocks | Syntax highlighting via lowlight | v0.4.0 |
| 🖼️ Images | Image preview with loading states | v0.5.0 |
| 🔗 Links | Clickable link rendering | v0.5.0 |
| 🧩 Editable Tables (Advanced) | Optional table editor with inline cells + source toggle | v0.5.1 |

## Installation

```bash
npm install codemirror-live-markdown
```

**Peer dependencies:**
```bash
npm install @codemirror/state @codemirror/view @codemirror/lang-markdown @codemirror/language @lezer/markdown
```

**Optional dependencies** (install only what you need):
```bash
npm install katex      # For math formulas
npm install lowlight   # For code syntax highlighting
```

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { EditorState } from '@codemirror/state';
import { EditorView } from '@codemirror/view';
import { markdown } from '@codemirror/lang-markdown';
import {
  livePreviewPlugin,
  markdownStylePlugin,
  editorTheme,
  mouseSelectingField,
  collapseOnSelectionFacet,
  setMouseSelecting,
} from 'codemirror-live-markdown';

const view = new EditorView({
  state: EditorState.create({
    doc: '# Hello World\n\nThis is **bold** and *italic* text.',
    extensions: [
      markdown(),
      collapseOnSelectionFacet.of(true),
      mouseSelectingField,
      livePreviewPlugin,
      markdownStylePlugin,
      editorTheme,
    ],
  }),
  parent: document.getElementById('editor')!,
});

// Required: Track mouse selection state
view.contentDOM.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
  view.dispatch({ effects: setMouseSelecting.of(true) });
});
document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    view.dispatch({ effects: setMouseSelecting.of(false) });
  });
});
```

## Documentation

### Adding Optional Features

Each feature is a separate plugin. Import and add only what you need:

```typescript
import { Table } from '@lezer/markdown';
import {
  mathPlugin,
  blockMathField,
  tableField,
  tableEditorPlugin,
  codeBlockField,
  codeBlockEditorPlugin,
  imageField,
  linkPlugin,
} from 'codemirror-live-markdown';

const extensions = [
  markdown({ extensions: [Table] }), // Enable GFM tables in parser
  // ... core extensions from Quick Start
  
  // Optional features:
  mathPlugin,                        // Inline math: `$E=mc^2$`
  blockMathField,                    // Block math: ```math
  tableField,                        // GFM tables
  tableEditorPlugin(),               // Editable tables with source toggle
  codeBlockField({ copyButton: true }), // Code blocks with syntax highlighting
  codeBlockEditorPlugin({ copyButton: true }), // Code blocks with MD/Code toggle
  imageField(),                      // Image preview
  linkPlugin(),                      // Link rendering
];
```

### Code Block Options

```typescript
codeBlockField({
  lineNumbers: false,      // Show line numbers
  copyButton: true,        // Show copy button
  defaultLanguage: 'text', // Fallback language
  interaction: 'auto',     // 'auto' | 'toggle'
})
```

- `interaction: 'auto'` (default): enter source mode when cursor enters code block.
- `interaction: 'toggle'`: keep rendered mode by default and switch with `MD` / `Code` buttons.

### Code Block Editor Plugin

```typescript
codeBlockEditorPlugin({
  copyButton: true,
  lineNumbers: false,
  defaultLanguage: 'text',
})
```

`codeBlockEditorPlugin()` is a non-breaking convenience API for `codeBlockField({ interaction: 'toggle' })`.

### Registering Additional Languages

```typescript
import { registerLanguage, initHighlighter } from 'codemirror-live-markdown';
import rust from 'highlight.js/lib/languages/rust';

// Initialize highlighter (required before first use)
await initHighlighter();

// Register additional languages
registerLanguage('rust', rust);
```

### Theming

Customize with CSS variables:

```css
:root {
  --md-heading: #1a1a1a;
  --md-bold: #1a1a1a;
  --md-italic: #1a1a1a;
  --md-link: #2563eb;
  --md-code-bg: #f5f5f5;
}
```

## API Reference

### Core Extensions

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `livePreviewPlugin` | Main live preview behavior |
| `markdownStylePlugin` | Styling for headers, bold, italic, etc. |
| `editorTheme` | Default theme with animations |
| `mouseSelectingField` | Tracks drag selection state |
| `collapseOnSelectionFacet` | Enable/disable live preview |

### Feature Extensions

| Export | Description | Requires |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| `mathPlugin` | Inline math rendering | `katex` |
| `blockMathField` | Block math rendering | `katex` |
| `tableField` | Table rendering | `@lezer/markdown` Table |
| `tableEditorPlugin()` | Editable table rendering | `@lezer/markdown` Table |
| `codeBlockField(options?)` | Code block highlighting | `lowlight` |
| `codeBlockEditorPlugin(options?)` | Code block editable preview with MD/Code toggle | `lowlight` |
| `setCodeBlockSourceMode` | Toggle code block source mode via effect | — |
| `imageField(options?)` | Image preview | — |
| `linkPlugin(options?)` | Link rendering | — |

### Utilities

| Export | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `shouldShowSource(state, from, to)` | Check if range should show source |
| `renderMath(source, displayMode)` | Render LaTeX to HTML |
| `highlightCode(code, lang?)` | Highlight code string |
| `initHighlighter()` | Initialize syntax highlighter |
| `isHighlighterAvailable()` | Check if highlighter is ready |

## Development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/blueberrycongee/codemirror-live-markdown.git
cd codemirror-live-markdown
npm install
npm run dev      # Watch mode
npm test         # Run tests
npm run build    # Production build
```

**Run the demo:**
```bash
cd demo
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please read our contributing guidelines before submitting a PR.

1. Fork the repository
2. Create your feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`)
3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add amazing feature'`)
4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`)
5. Open a Pull Request

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE) © [blueberrycongee](https://github.com/blueberrycongee)

## Acknowledgments

- Inspired by [Obsidian](https://obsidian.md/)'s Live Preview mode

## Technical Summary: CodeMirror 6 Live Preview Decoration Mechanism

---

### File 1: `src/plugins/livePreview.ts`

#### 1. Exports
- **Name:** `livePreviewPlugin`
- **Type:** `ViewPlugin` (from `ViewPlugin.fromClass()`)

#### 2. ViewPlugin Structure
```typescript
ViewPlugin.fromClass(class {
  decorations: DecorationSet;
  
  constructor(view: EditorView) { this.decorations = this.build(view); }
  
  update(update: ViewUpdate) {
    if (checkUpdateAction(update) === 'rebuild') {
      this.decorations = this.build(update.view);
    }
  }
  
  build(view: EditorView) { /* ... */ }
}, {
  decorations: (v) => v.decorations, // provide function
})
```
- **Decoration type:** `Decoration.mark()` exclusively (lines 122, 135)
- **Decoration building:** `Decoration.set(sortedDecorations, true)` (line 141-143)
- **provide:** Uses `decorations` property in extension spec (line 148)

#### 3. Markdown Syntax Elements Handled

**Mark Nodes (syntax tree nodes):**
| Node Type | Syntax | Category |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| `EmphasisMark` | `*` or `_` | Inline |
| `StrikethroughMark` | `~~` | Inline |
| `CodeMark` | `` ` `` | Inline |
| `HeaderMark` | `#` | Block |
| `ListMark` | `-` or `*` | Block |
| `QuoteMark` | `>` | Block |

**How it hides them:** NOT hidden. Instead, it applies CSS classes that trigger animations:
- **Block marks:** `cm-formatting-block` → adds `cm-formatting-block-visible` when active line
- **Inline marks:** `cm-formatting-inline` → adds `cm-formatting-inline-visible` when touched
- Uses `Decoration.mark({ class: cls })` to wrap the mark characters (NOT `Decoration.replace`)

#### 4. `shouldShowSource` Usage

```typescript
// Line 128
const isTouched = shouldShowSource(state, node.from, node.to);
const cls = isTouched && !isDrag
  ? 'cm-formatting-inline cm-formatting-inline-visible'
  : 'cm-formatting-inline';
```

**Logic:**
- **Inline marks:** Calls `shouldShowSource(state, from, to)` to check if cursor touches the mark range
- **Block marks:** Uses line-based detection via `activeLines.has(lineNum)` (lines 66-73, 113)
- **Drag state:** If `isDrag` is true, forces marks to be invisible (prevents flickering)

#### 5. Syntax Tree / @lezer/markdown Node Iteration

```typescript
// Line 78

<result># MATH Subsystem Technical Summary

## Overview
The MATH subsystem provides live preview rendering of mathematical formulas using KaTeX, supporting both inline (`$...$`) and block (```math ... ```) formats. It uses a dual-architecture approach: ViewPlugin for inline math and StateField for block math.

---

## 1. src/plugins/math.ts

### Exact Exports

**Line 36-93:** `mathPlugin: ViewPlugin`
```typescript
export const mathPlugin = ViewPlugin.fromClass(...)
```
Type: `ViewPlugin` (via `ViewPlugin.fromClass`)

**Line 152-181:** `blockMathField: StateField<DecorationSet>`
```typescript
export const blockMathField = StateField.define<DecorationSet>({...})
```
Type: `StateField<DecorationSet>`

### How mathPlugin Works (Inline Math `$...$`)

**Architecture (Lines 36-93):**
```typescript
export const mathPlugin = ViewPlugin.fromClass(
  class {
    decorations: DecorationSet;
    
    constructor(view: EditorView) {
      this.decorations = this.build(view);
    }
    
    update(update: ViewUpdate) {
      if (checkUpdateAction(update) === 'rebuild') {
        this.decorations = this.build(update.view);
      }
    }
    // ...
  },
  { decorations: (v) => v.decorations }
);
```

**Decoration Building Process (Lines 50-88):**
```typescript
build(view: EditorView): DecorationSet {
  const decorations: Range<Decoration>[] = [];
  const { state } = view;
  const isDrag = state.field(mouseSelectingField, false);

  syntaxTree(state).iterate({
    enter: (node) => {
      // Only handle inline formulas
      if (node.name === 'InlineCode') {
        const fullText = state.doc.sliceString(node.from, node.to);

        if (
          fullText.startsWith('`$') &&
          fullText.endsWith('$`') &&
          fullText.length > 4
        ) {
          const source = fullText.slice(2, -2);
          const isTouched = shouldShowSource(state, node.from, node.to);

          if (!isTouched && !isDrag) {
            // RENDER MODE: Replace with widget
            const widget = createMathWidget(source, false);
            decorations.push(
              Decoration.replace({ widget }).range(node.from, node.to)
            );
          } else {
            // EDIT MODE: Mark with CSS class
            decorations.push(
              Decoration.mark({ class: 'cm-math-source' }).range(
                node.from,
                node.to
              )
            );
          }
        }
      }
    },
  });

  return Decoration.set(decorations.sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from), true);
}
```

**Key Mechanisms:**
- **shouldShowSource**: Determines if cursor is touching the formula (line 67)
- **Decoration.replace**: Replaces inline code node with rendered widget (line 71)
- **Decoration.mark**: Adds CSS class when showing source (line 76)
- **isDrag check**: Prevents flickering during mouse selection (line 53)

### How blockMathField Works (Block Math ```math ```)

**StateField Definition (Lines 152-181):**
```typescript
export const blockMathField = StateField.define<DecorationSet>({
  create(state) {
    return buildBlockMathDecorations(state);
  },

  update(deco, tr) {
    // Rebuild on document changes
    if (tr.docChanged || tr.reconfigured) {
      return buildBlockMathDecorations(tr.state);
    }

    // Handle drag state changes
    const isDragging = tr.state.field(mouseSelectingField, false);
    const wasDragging = tr.startState.field(mouseSelectingField, false);

    if (wasDragging && !isDragging) {
      return buildBlockMathDecorations(tr.state);
    }

    if (isDragging) {
      return deco;
    }

    // Rebuild on selection changes
    if (tr.selection) {
      return buildBlockMathDecorations(tr.state);
    }

    return deco;
  },

  provide: (f) => EditorView.decorations.from(f),
});
```

**Block Decoration Building (Lines 98-144):**
```typescript
function buildBlockMathDecorations(state: EditorState): DecorationSet {
  const decorations: Range<Decoration>[] = [];
  const isDrag = state.field(mouseSelectingField, false);

  syntaxTree(state).iterate({
    enter: (node) => {
      if (node.name === 'FencedCode') {
        const codeInfo = node.node.getChild('CodeInfo');
        if (codeInfo) {
          const lang = state.doc.sliceString(codeInfo.from, codeInfo.to);

          if (lang === 'math') {
            const codeText = node.node.getChild('CodeText');
            const source = codeText
              ? state.doc.sliceString(codeText.from, codeText.to).trim()
              : '';
            const isTouched = shouldShowSource(state, node.from, node.to);

            if (!isTouched && !isDrag) {
              // Show rendered result
              const widget = createMathWidget(source, true);
              decorations.push(
                Decoration.replace({ widget, block: true }).range(
                  node.from,
                  node.to
                )
              );

```typescript
build(view: EditorView): DecorationSet {
  const decorations: Range<Decoration>[] = [];
  const { state } = view;
  const isDrag = state.field(mouseSelectingField, false);

  syntaxTree(state).iterate({
    enter: (node) => {
      // Only handle inline formulas
      if (node.name === 'InlineCode') {
        const fullText = state.doc.sliceString(node.from, node.to);

        if (
          fullText.startsWith('`$') &&
          fullText.endsWith('$`') &&
          fullText.length > 4
        ) {
          const source = fullText.slice(2, -2);
          const isTouched = shouldShowSource(state, node.from, node.to);

          if (!isTouched && !isDrag) {
            // RENDER MODE: Replace with widget
            const widget = createMathWidget(source, false);
            decorations.push(
              Decoration.replace({ widget }).range(node.from, node.to)
            );
          } else {
            // EDIT MODE: Mark with CSS class
            decorations.push(
              Decoration.mark({ class: 'cm-math-source' }).range(
                node.from,
                node.to
              )
            );
          }
        }
      }
    },
  });

  return Decoration.set(decorations.sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from), true);
}
```

**Block Decoration Building (Lines 98-144):**
```typescript
function buildBlockMathDecorations(state: EditorState): DecorationSet {
  const decorations: Range<Decoration>[] = [];
  const isDrag = state.field(mouseSelectingField, false);

  syntaxTree(state).iterate({
    enter: (node) => {
      if (node.name === 'FencedCode') {
        const codeInfo = node.node.getChild('CodeInfo');
        if (codeInfo) {
          const lang = state.doc.sliceString(codeInfo.from, codeInfo.to);

          if (lang === 'math') {
            const codeText = node.node.getChild('CodeText');
            const source = codeText
              ? state.doc.sliceString(codeText.from, codeText.to).trim()
              : '';
            const isTouched = shouldShowSource(state, node.from, node.to);

            if (!isTouched && !isDrag) {
              // Show rendered result
              const widget = createMathWidget(source, true);
              decorations.push(
                Decoration.replace({ widget, block: true }).range(
                  node.from,
                  node.to
                )
              );
            } else {
              // Edit mode: add background to each line
              for (let pos = node.from; pos <= node.to; ) {
                const line = state.doc.lineAt(pos);
                decorations.push(
                  Decoration.line({ class: 'cm-math-source-block' }).range(
                    line.from
                  )
                );
                pos = line.to + 1;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
  });

  return Decoration.set(decorations.sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from), true);
}
```

> Block decorations must be provided via StateField (ViewPlugin cannot handle block decorations)

### Caching Strategy

**Cache Storage (Line 11):**

**Key format:** `"inline:formula"` or `"block:formula"` (line 27)

**Rendering with Cache (Lines 26-55):**
```typescript
export function renderMath(source: string, displayMode: boolean): string {
  const key = `${displayMode ? 'block' : 'inline'}:${source}`;

  // Cache hit
  if (cache.has(key)) {
    return cache.get(key)!;
  }

  // Cache miss - render with KaTeX
  try {
    const katex = window.katex;

    if (!katex) {
      throw new Error('KaTeX not found. Please install katex package.');
    }

    const rendered = katex.renderToString(source, {
      displayMode,
      throwOnError: false,
      errorColor: '#cc0000',
      strict: false,
    });

    cache.set(key, rendered);
    return rendered;
  } catch (error) {
    const errorMsg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';
    return `<span class="cm-math-error">[Math Error: ${errorMsg}]</span>`;
  }
}
```

**Cache Clearing (Lines 62-64):**
```typescript
export function clearMathCache(): void {
  cache.clear();
}
```

### Why Caching Matters

**Performance Benefits:**
1. **KaTeX is expensive**: Mathematical parsing and rendering is computationally intensive
2. **Repeated formulas**: Documents often reuse formulas (e.g., `$E = mc^2$` appearing multiple times)
3. **Edit mode switching**: When toggling between rendered/source modes, cached results prevent redundant rendering
4. **Cursor movement**: `shouldShowSource` checks trigger rebuilds; cache avoids re-rendering unchanged formulas

**Cache Key Design:**
- Prefix (`inline:`/`block:`) ensures inline and block versions of same formula are cached separately
- Full source string as suffix ensures formula-specific caching
- Example keys: `"inline:\alpha"`, `"block:\int_0^\infty e^{-x} dx"`

### 5.7 Precise Click Position Measurement (Lines 298-361)

```typescript
private measureClickOffset(
  lineEl: HTMLElement,
  clientX: number,
  sourceText: string
): number {
  const rect = lineEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clickX = clientX - rect.left;

  const style = window.getComputedStyle(lineEl);
  const paddingLeft = parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) || 0;
  const textClickX = clickX - paddingLeft;

  if (textClickX <= 0) return 0;

  // Use Canvas to measure text width
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  if (!ctx) {
    // Fallback estimation
    const fontSize = parseFloat(style.fontSize) || 16;
    const charWidth = fontSize * 0.6;
    return Math.min(Math.floor(textClickX / charWidth), sourceText.length);
  }

  ctx.font = `${style.fontSize} ${style.fontFamily}`;

  // Binary search for character at click position
  let left = 0;
  let right = text.length;

  while (left < right) {
    const mid = Math.floor((left + right + 1) / 2);
    const width = ctx.measureText(text.substring(0, mid)).width;

    if (width <= textClickX) {
      left = mid;
    } else {
      right = mid - 1;
    }
  }

  // Check if closer to next character (midpoint adjustment)
  if (left < text.length) {
    const currentWidth = ctx.measureText(text.substring(0, left)).width;
    const nextWidth = ctx.measureText(text.substring(0, left + 1)).width;
    const midPoint = (currentWidth + nextWidth) / 2;

    if (textClickX > midPoint) {
      left++;
    }
  }

  return Math.min(left, sourceText.length);
}
```

export function highlightCode(code: string, lang?: string): HighlightResult {

interface HastNode {
  type: string;
  value?: string;
  tagName?: string;
  properties?: { className?: string[] };
  children?: HastNode[];
}

function hastToMarkDecorations(root: HastNode, basePos: number): Range<Decoration>[] {
  const result: Range<Decoration>[] = [];
  let offset = 0;

  function walk(node: HastNode, cls?: string) {
    if (node.type === 'text') {
      const len = node.value?.length || 0;
      if (cls && len > 0) {
        result.push(
          Decoration.mark({ class: cls }).range(
            basePos + offset,
            basePos + offset + len
          )
        );
      }
      offset += len;
    } else if (node.type === 'element' || node.type === 'root') {
      const nodeClass = node.properties?.className?.join(' ');
      const effectiveClass = nodeClass || cls;
      if (node.children) {
        for (const child of node.children) {
          walk(child, effectiveClass);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  walk(root);
  return result;
}
```

      if (options.interaction !== 'auto') {

      if (tr.selection) {

      return deco;

### 5.7 Precise Click Position Measurement (Lines 298-361)

```typescript
private measureClickOffset(
  lineEl: HTMLElement,
  clientX: number,
  sourceText: string
): number {
  const rect = lineEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clickX = clientX - rect.left;

  const style = window.getComputedStyle(lineEl);
  const paddingLeft = parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) || 0;
  const textClickX = clickX - paddingLeft;

  if (textClickX <= 0) return 0;

  // Use Canvas to measure text width
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  if (!ctx) {
    // Fallback estimation
    const fontSize = parseFloat(style.fontSize) || 16;
    const charWidth = fontSize * 0.6;
    return Math.min(Math.floor(textClickX / charWidth), sourceText.length);
  }

  ctx.font = `${style.fontSize} ${style.fontFamily}`;

  // Binary search for character at click position
  let left = 0;
  let right = text.length;

  while (left < right) {
    const mid = Math.floor((left + right + 1) / 2);
    const width = ctx.measureText(text.substring(0, mid)).width;

    if (width <= textClickX) {
      left = mid;
    } else {
      right = mid - 1;
    }
  }

  // Check if closer to next character (midpoint adjustment)
  if (left < text.length) {
    const currentWidth = ctx.measureText(text.substring(0, left)).width;
    const nextWidth = ctx.measureText(text.substring(0, left + 1)).width;
    const midPoint = (currentWidth + nextWidth) / 2;

    if (textClickX > midPoint) {
      left++;
    }
  }

  return Math.min(left, sourceText.length);
}
```

### 6.3 HAST to Mark Decorations (codeBlock.ts lines 254-286)

For inline mode, HAST is converted to mark decorations:

```typescript
interface HastNode {
  type: string;
  value?: string;
  tagName?: string;
  properties?: { className?: string[] };
  children?: HastNode[];
}

function hastToMarkDecorations(root: HastNode, basePos: number): Range<Decoration>[] {
  const result: Range<Decoration>[] = [];
  let offset = 0;

  function walk(node: HastNode, cls?: string) {
    if (node.type === 'text') {
      const len = node.value?.length || 0;
      if (cls && len > 0) {
        result.push(
          Decoration.mark({ class: cls }).range(
            basePos + offset,
            basePos + offset + len
          )
        );
      }
      offset += len;
    } else if (node.type === 'element' || node.type === 'root') {
      const nodeClass = node.properties?.className?.join(' ');
      const effectiveClass = nodeClass || cls;
      if (node.children) {
        for (const child of node.children) {
          walk(child, effectiveClass);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  walk(root);
  return result;
}
```

### 5.7 Precise Click Position Measurement (Lines 298-361)

```typescript
private measureClickOffset(
  lineEl: HTMLElement,
  clientX: number,
  sourceText: string
): number {
  const rect = lineEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clickX = clientX - rect.left;

  const style = window.getComputedStyle(lineEl);
  const paddingLeft = parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) || 0;
  const textClickX = clickX - paddingLeft;

  if (textClickX <= 0) return 0;

  // Use Canvas to measure text width
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  if (!ctx) {
    // Fallback estimation
    const fontSize = parseFloat(style.fontSize) || 16;
    const charWidth = fontSize * 0.6;
    return Math.min(Math.floor(textClickX / charWidth), sourceText.length);
  }

  ctx.font = `${style.fontSize} ${style.fontFamily}`;

  // Binary search for character at click position
  let left = 0;
  let right = text.length;

  while (left < right) {
    const mid = Math.floor((left + right + 1) / 2);
    const width = ctx.measureText(text.substring(0, mid)).width;

    if (width <= textClickX) {
      left = mid;
    } else {
      right = mid - 1;
    }
  }

  // Check if closer to next character (midpoint adjustment)
  if (left < text.length) {
    const currentWidth = ctx.measureText(text.substring(0, left)).width;
    const nextWidth = ctx.measureText(text.substring(0, left + 1)).width;
    const midPoint = (currentWidth + nextWidth) / 2;

    if (textClickX > midPoint) {
      left++;
    }
  }

  return Math.min(left, sourceText.length);
}
```

### 6.3 HAST to Mark Decorations (codeBlock.ts lines 254-286)

For inline mode, HAST is converted to mark decorations:

```typescript
interface HastNode {
  type: string;
  value?: string;
  tagName?: string;
  properties?: { className?: string[] };
  children?: HastNode[];
}

function hastToMarkDecorations(root: HastNode, basePos: number): Range<Decoration>[] {
  const result: Range<Decoration>[] = [];
  let offset = 0;

  function walk(node: HastNode, cls?: string) {
    if (node.type === 'text') {
      const len = node.value?.length || 0;
      if (cls && len > 0) {
        result.push(
          Decoration.mark({ class: cls }).range(
            basePos + offset,
            basePos + offset + len
          )
        );
      }
      offset += len;
    } else if (node.type === 'element' || node.type === 'root') {
      const nodeClass = node.properties?.className?.join(' ');
      const effectiveClass = nodeClass || cls;
      if (node.children) {
        for (const child of node.children) {
          walk(child, effectiveClass);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  walk(root);
  return result;
}
```

export function resolveImagePath(src: string, basePath?: string): string {
  // Data URLs → return as-is
  if (src.startsWith('data:')) return src;
  
  // Absolute URLs → return as-is
  if (src.startsWith('http://') || src.startsWith('https://')) return src;
  
  // Relative paths with basePath
  if (basePath) {
    // SECURITY: Remove path traversal attacks
    const sanitizedSrc = src.replace(/\.\.\//g, '').replace(/^\.\//g, '');
    const normalizedBase = basePath.endsWith('/') ? basePath : basePath + '/';
    return normalizedBase + sanitizedSrc;
  }
  
  return src;
}

export function resolveImagePath(src: string, basePath?: string): string {
  // Data URLs → return as-is
  if (src.startsWith('data:')) return src;

}

function createEditableCell(
  tag: 'th' | 'td',
  value: string,
  onCommit: (nextValue: string) => void
): HTMLTableCellElement {
  const cell = document.createElement(tag);
  cell.className = 'cm-table-cell';
  cell.contentEditable = 'true';
  cell.spellcheck = false;
  cell.dataset.raw = value;  // Store original value
  cell.innerHTML = renderInlineMarkdown(value);  // Render initial display
  
  let editing = false;
  
  const commitIfChanged = () => {
    const nextValue = cell.textContent ?? '';
    const raw = cell.dataset.raw ?? '';
    if (nextValue === raw) return;
    cell.dataset.raw = nextValue;
    onCommit(nextValue);  // Callback to update markdown
  };
  
  // Focus: switch to plain text editing (lines 41-46)
  cell.addEventListener('focus', () => {
    if (!editing) {
      editing = true;
      cell.textContent = cell.dataset.raw ?? '';
    }
  });
  
  // Blur: commit changes and re-render markdown (lines 48-53)
  cell.addEventListener('blur', (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    commitIfChanged();
    editing = false;
    cell.innerHTML = renderInlineMarkdown(cell.dataset.raw ?? '');
  });
  
  // Enter key: commit and exit (lines 55-61)
  cell.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      commitIfChanged();
      cell.blur();
    }
  });
  
  return cell;
}

function parseRow(line: string): string[] {
  // Replace escaped pipes with placeholder first
  const placeholder = '\x00PIPE\x00';
  const escaped = line.replace(/\\\|/g, placeholder);
  
  // Split by pipe
  const cells = escaped.split('|');
  
  // Remove empty cells at start/end (due to |col1|col2| format)
  if (cells.length > 0 && cells[0].trim() === '') cells.shift();
  if (cells.length > 0 && cells[cells.length - 1].trim() === '') cells.pop();
  
  // Restore placeholder and clean up
  return cells.map((cell) =>
    cell.replace(new RegExp(placeholder, 'g'), '|').trim()
  );
}
```

**`parseAlignment` Function (Lines 40-49):**
```typescript
function parseAlignment(cell: string): 'left' | 'center' | 'right' | null {
  const trimmed = cell.trim();
  const left = trimmed.startsWith(':');
  const right = trimmed.endsWith(':');
  
  if (left && right) return 'center';   // :---:
  if (left) return 'left';              // :---
  if (right) return 'right';            // ---:
  return null;                          // ---
}
```

function isSeparatorRow(cells: string[]): boolean {
  if (cells.length === 0) return false;
  return cells.every((cell) => /^:?-+:?$/.test(cell.trim()));
}

export function parseMarkdownTable(source: string): TableData | null {
  const lines = source.split('\n').filter((line) => line.trim() !== '');
  
  if (lines.length < 2) return null;  // Need header + separator
  
  // Parse header
  const headerCells = parseRow(lines[0]);
  if (headerCells.length === 0) return null;
  
  // Parse separator row
  const separatorCells = parseRow(lines[1]);
  if (!isSeparatorRow(separatorCells)) return null;
  
  // Column count must match

function createEditableCell(
  tag: 'th' | 'td',
  value: string,
  onCommit: (nextValue: string) => void
): HTMLTableCellElement {
  const cell = document.createElement(tag);
  cell.className = 'cm-table-cell';
  cell.contentEditable = 'true';
  cell.spellcheck = false;
  cell.dataset.raw = value;  // Store original value
  cell.innerHTML = renderInlineMarkdown(value);  // Render initial display
  
  let editing = false;
  
  const commitIfChanged = () => {
    const nextValue = cell.textContent ?? '';
    const raw = cell.dataset.raw ?? '';
    if (nextValue === raw) return;
    cell.dataset.raw = nextValue;
    onCommit(nextValue);  // Callback to update markdown
  };
  
  // Focus: switch to plain text editing (lines 41-46)
  cell.addEventListener('focus', () => {
    if (!editing) {
      editing = true;
      cell.textContent = cell.dataset.raw ?? '';
    }
  });
  
  // Blur: commit changes and re-render markdown (lines 48-53)
  cell.addEventListener('blur', (event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    commitIfChanged();
    editing = false;
    cell.innerHTML = renderInlineMarkdown(cell.dataset.raw ?? '');
  });
  
  // Enter key: commit and exit (lines 55-61)
  cell.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      commitIfChanged();
      cell.blur();
    }
  });
  
  return cell;
}
```

**`parseRow` Function (Lines 19-35):**
```typescript
function parseRow(line: string): string[] {
  // Replace escaped pipes with placeholder first
  const placeholder = '\x00PIPE\x00';
  const escaped = line.replace(/\\\|/g, placeholder);
  
  // Split by pipe
  const cells = escaped.split('|');
  
  // Remove empty cells at start/end (due to |col1|col2| format)
  if (cells.length > 0 && cells[0].trim() === '') cells.shift();
  if (cells.length > 0 && cells[cells.length - 1].trim() === '') cells.pop();
  
  // Restore placeholder and clean up
  return cells.map((cell) =>
    cell.replace(new RegExp(placeholder, 'g'), '|').trim()
  );
}
```

**`parseAlignment` Function (Lines 40-49):**
```typescript
function parseAlignment(cell: string): 'left' | 'center' | 'right' | null {
  const trimmed = cell.trim();
  const left = trimmed.startsWith(':');
  const right = trimmed.endsWith(':');
  
  if (left && right) return 'center';   // :---:
  if (left) return 'left';              // :---
  if (right) return 'right';            // ---:
  return null;                          // ---
}
```

**`isSeparatorRow` Function (Lines 54-57):**
```typescript
function isSeparatorRow(cells: string[]): boolean {
  if (cells.length === 0) return false;
  return cells.every((cell) => /^:?-+:?$/.test(cell.trim()));
}
```

**`parseMarkdownTable` Function (Lines 65-98):**

```typescript
export function parseMarkdownTable(source: string): TableData | null {
  const lines = source.split('\n').filter((line) => line.trim() !== '');
  
  if (lines.length < 2) return null;  // Need header + separator
  
  // Parse header
  const headerCells = parseRow(lines[0]);
  if (headerCells.length === 0) return null;
  
  // Parse separator row
  const separatorCells = parseRow(lines[1]);
  if (!isSeparatorRow(separatorCells)) return null;
  
  // Column count must match
  if (headerCells.length !== separatorCells.length) return null;
  
  // Parse alignments
  const alignments = separatorCells.map(parseAlignment);
  
  // Parse data rows (lines 85-91)
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  for (let i = 2; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const rowCells = parseRow(lines[i]);
    // Pad or truncate to header column count
    const normalizedRow = headerCells.map((_, idx) => rowCells[idx] ?? '');
    rows.push(normalizedRow);
  }
  
  return { headers: headerCells, alignments, rows };
}
```

**Parsing Rules:**
1. Minimum 2 lines (header + separator)
2. Second line must be separator row (`---`, `:---`, `---:`, `:---:` pattern)
3. Separator cell count must match header cell count
4. Data rows are padded/truncated to match header column count
5. Escaped pipes (`\|`) are preserved in cell content

  if (alignment === 'right') return '---:';
  if (alignment === 'center') return ':---:';
  return '---';
}

**`serializeMarkdownTable` Function (Lines 20-30):**
```typescript
export function serializeMarkdownTable(data: TableData): string {
  const headerLine = `| ${data.headers.map(escapeCell).join(' | ')} |`;
  const separatorLine = `| ${data.alignments
    .map(alignmentCell)
    .join(' | ')} |`;
  const rowLines = data.rows.map(
    (row) => `| ${row.map(escapeCell).join(' | ')} |`
  );
  
  return [headerLine, separatorLine, ...rowLines].join('\n');
}
```

**Output Format:**
```markdown
| header1 | header2 | header3 |
| :--- | ---: | :---: |
| cell1 | cell2 | cell3 |
```

input.rationale: 学习路线围绕一条主线展开：shouldShowSource 决策函数 + 两种装饰策略（Decoration.mark 配 CSS 隐藏标记 vs Decoration.replace 配 Widget 替换渲染）。第一单元从零开始，讲清项目定位、源码目录、库入口、构建运行 demo 和第一次集成；第二单元铺开 Live Preview 的核心机制（CodeMirror 6 概念、shouldShowSource、Facet/mouseSelecting/checkUpdateAction、livePreviewPlugin、markdownStylePlugin），这是理解一切的基础；第三单元以数学公式为范例引入 WidgetType+Decoration.replace 的渲染模式，并说明行内用 ViewPlugin、块级必须用 StateField 的关键区别；第四单元按"解析↔序列化↔渲染↔可编辑"的顺序讲表格子系统；第五单元把代码块放到专家层，因为它是当前最复杂的模块（auto/toggle/inline 三种交互、Canvas 点击定位、HAST 高亮、源码模式切换）；第六单元讲图片（异步加载+双缓存+路径安全）与链接（URL 净化+Wiki 链接）；最后第七单元回到主题、测试、整体架构取舍与自定义插件开发。依赖关系设计为先核心机制后特性模块，先简单（math/table）后复杂（codeBlock），代码块作为压轴专家内容。

lectures.title: 项目定位与功能总览
lectures.topic: 介绍 codemirror-live-markdown 是什么：一个为 CodeMirror 6 提供 Obsidian 风格 Live Preview 的模块化插件集合，以及它的核心功能、版本演进和模块化设计理念。
learning_goals: 理解 Live Preview（实时预览）与源码模式、阅读模式的区别
掌握项目的模块化、零强制依赖、按需引入的核心理念
了解项目从 v0.1 到 v0.5 的功能演进路线
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 README 的功能矩阵表，列出当前版本支持的全部特性，并用一句话说明每个特性对应的扩展点（core 还是 optional）。

lectures.title: 源码目录结构与库入口
lectures.topic: 讲解 src 目录的组织（core/plugins/widgets/utils/theme）以及 src/index.ts 作为统一导出入口如何把所有扩展、工具、类型汇聚给使用者。
learning_goals: 熟悉 src 下 core/plugins/widgets/utils/theme 五个分层各自的职责
看懂 src/index.ts 如何分类导出（Core / Plugins / Theme / Utils）
理解 peerDependencies 与可选依赖（katex/lowlight）的作用
lectures.practice_task: 在 src/index.ts 中追踪 livePreviewPlugin、mathPlugin、codeBlockField、imageField 分别来自哪个子模块文件，画一张导出关系图。

lectures.title: 构建、测试与运行 demo
lectures.topic: 讲解如何使用 npm scripts 进行开发：tsup 构建（ESM+CJS+dts）、Vitest 测试（jsdom 环境）、以及如何启动 demo 查看真实效果，并介绍 CI 流程。
learning_goals: 掌握 npm run dev/build/test/typecheck/lint 各脚本的作用
理解 tsup 配置如何产出多格式包并 external 掉 CodeMirror 依赖
学会在本地跑起 demo 看到五种编辑器配置
lectures.practice_task: 运行 npm install && npm test 确认测试通过，再进入 demo 目录运行 npm run dev，在浏览器中打开页面确认 5 个编辑器都能渲染。

lectures.title: 快速集成：搭建第一个 Live Preview 编辑器
lectures.topic: 基于 README 的 Quick Start 和 demo/main.ts，讲解如何在任意 CodeMirror 6 编辑器中接入库，重点说明 collapseOnSelectionFacet、mouseSelectingField 与 mousedown/mouseup 派发 setMouseSelecting 的必备接线。
learning_goals: 掌握核心扩展的最小组合（livePreviewPlugin + markdownStylePlugin + editorTheme + facet + mouseSelectingField）

学会用 Compartment 在 Live/Source 模式间动态切换
lectures.practice_task: 仿照 demo/main.ts，新建一个最小 HTML 页面，挂载一个 CodeMirror 编辑器，启用 livePreviewPlugin 并正确接线 mouseSelecting，输入 **粗体** 观察标记在光标进入时显隐。

lectures.title: CodeMirror 6 核心概念速览
lectures.topic: 为后续读源码铺垫 CodeMirror 6 的核心概念：EditorState、EditorView、Transaction、Decoration（mark/replace/widget/line）、StateField、ViewPlugin、Facet、Compartment，以及 Lezer 语法树 syntaxTree。
learning_goals: 理解 EditorState 不可变模型与 Transaction 更新机制
区分 ViewPlugin 与 StateField 提供装饰的两种方式

lectures.title: shouldShowSource：显示源码还是渲染
lectures.topic: 深入讲解整个 Live Preview 的决策核心函数 shouldShowSource：它依据 collapseOnSelectionFacet 是否启用、mouseSelectingField 是否在拖拽、选区是否与目标区间相交，决定一段 Markdown 是显示源码还是渲染结果。

lectures.title: 状态支撑：Facet、mouseSelecting 与 checkUpdateAction
lectures.topic: 讲解支撑 Live Preview 的三块核心状态：collapseOnSelectionFacet（开关）、mouseSelectingField（拖拽状态 StateField + setMouseSelecting Effect）、checkUpdateAction（统一判断 ViewPlugin 何时 rebuild/skip/none）。
learning_goals: 掌握 Facet.define 的 combine 用法与开关语义

读懂 checkUpdateAction 如何用 docChanged/viewportChanged/drag/selection 推导更新动作

lectures.title: livePreviewPlugin：用 CSS 动画隐藏标记
lectures.topic: 讲解 livePreviewPlugin 如何遍历语法树找到标记节点（EmphasisMark/StrikethroughMark/CodeMark/HeaderMark/ListMark/QuoteMark），用 Decoration.mark 套 CSS 类，结合 shouldShowSource 决定是否加 visible 类，实现平滑显隐动画。

掌握用 syntaxTree.iterate 过滤特定 node.name 的写法
看懂 isInsideSkippedParent 如何跳过 FencedCode/CodeBlock 内部的标记

lectures.title: tableEditorPlugin：可编辑表格与 source mode 切换
lectures.topic: 讲解 tableEditorPlugin 的可编辑表格方案：tableSourceModeField 用 setTableSourceMode Effect 跟踪每张表的源码态，TableEditorWidget 用 contenteditable 单元格，编辑后通过 commit 回调→serializeMarkdownTable→view.dispatch 把改动写回文档。
learning_goals: 掌握 setTableSourceMode StateEffect 与 rangesOverlap/addRange/removeRange 区间管理
理解 contenteditable 单元格的 focus/blur/Enter 提交时机
看懂单元格编辑如何经 serialize→dispatch 写回 Markdown 文档
lectures.practice_task: 梳理一次单元格编辑的完整数据流：用户聚焦单元格→输入→失焦，列出每一步触发的回调、产生的 Effect/changes，以及最终文档如何被替换。

lectures.title: codeHighlight：lowlight 集成与懒加载
lectures.topic: 讲解 codeHighlight 工具如何用懒加载方式集成 lowlight：initHighlighter 异步初始化、isHighlighterAvailable 检查、highlightCode 返回 HTML、registerLanguage 注册额外语言，以及未安装 lowlight 时的优雅降级。
learning_goals: 理解 lowlight 模块的懒加载（动态 import）与同步/异步初始化策略
掌握 highlightCode 与 highlightCodeHast 的区别（HTML vs HAST）
看懂语言未注册或 lowlight 不可用时的降级处理
lectures.practice_task: 参照 README，编写一段调用 initHighlighter() 与 registerLanguage 注册一个新语言（如 rust）的代码，并说明在 lowlight 缺失时 highlightCode 会返回什么。

lectures.title: codeBlockField：三种交互模式 auto/toggle/inline
lectures.topic: 讲解 codeBlockField 如何识别 FencedCode 节点、跳过 math 等特殊语言，并支持三种 interaction：auto（光标进入显示源码）、toggle（显式 MD/Code 按钮切换）、inline（保留围栏内代码可原生编辑），以及 codeBlockSourceModeField 跟踪源码态。
learning_goals: 理解 CodeInfo 提取语言、SKIP_LANGUAGES 跳过 math 的机制
掌握三种 interaction 模式的渲染与更新差异（auto 依赖 selection，toggle/inline 不重建）
看懂 setCodeBlockSourceMode Effect 与 codeBlockSourceModeField 的区间映射
lectures.practice_task: 对比 codeBlockField({interaction:'auto'}) 与 codeBlockEditorPlugin()（即 toggle），在文档变化、选区变化、拖拽时各自的 update 是否重建装饰，写一张决策表。

lectures.title: codeBlockWidget：DOM 渲染、复制按钮与点击定位
lectures.topic: 深入 codeBlockWidget 的 toDOM 实现：工具栏（MD/Code/Copy 按钮）、按行渲染带 data-line-index 的代码、ignoreEvent 与 mousedown/mouseup/click 冒泡控制、以及用 Canvas 二分查找精确计算点击落在源码的字符位置。
learning_goals: 掌握代码块 Widget 的 DOM 结构与按行高亮渲染
理解 ignoreEvent 与 stopBubbleForBody 如何控制事件冒泡以兼顾按钮点击与编辑
看懂 measureClickOffset 用 Canvas measureText + 二分查找把点击坐标映射到源码位置
minimal_modules: toDOM 工具栏与按行渲染
lectures.practice_task: 说明 measureClickOffset 在 Canvas 不可用时如何退化为按字号估算字符宽度，并解释为什么需要把点击位置精确映射回源码 pos 才能让光标落在正确字符。

lectures.title: inline 模式：保留 contentDOM 的可编辑高亮
lectures.topic: 讲解 inline 交互模式的特殊性：只替换围栏行而把代码内容留在 contentDOM 内可原生编辑，用 highlightCodeHast 产出 HAST 树再经 hastToMarkDecorations 转成 Decoration.mark 高亮，并用 codeBlockSelectionPlugin 给选区加 cm-codeblock-sel 标记。
learning_goals: 理解 inline 模式为何只替换围栏行、保留代码文本在 contentDOM
掌握 highlightCodeHast + hastToMarkDecorations 把语法树节点转成 mark 装饰的递归遍历
看懂 codeBlockSelectionPlugin 如何用 Decoration.mark 处理行内选区高亮
lectures.practice_task: 对比 inline 模式与 auto 模式：分别说明代码内容是存在于 Widget DOM 还是 contentDOM，以及高亮是通过 innerHTML 还是 Decoration.mark 实现，列出各自优劣。

lectures.title: imageField：图片预览与加载状态
lectures.topic: 讲解 imageField（StateField）如何用正则解析 ![alt](url) 语法，结合 shouldShowSource 在 ImageWidget 渲染与 cm-image-source 源码态之间切换，以及 ImageWidget 的 loading/error 状态与异步加载渲染。
learning_goals: 理解 parseImageSyntax 的正则与 isLocal 判定
掌握 ImageWidget.toDOM 的 loading→loaded/error 状态机
看懂 shouldShowSource 控制图片渲染态与源码态切换
lectures.practice_task: 追踪一张远程图片从被解析到加载完成的完整过程：列出 parseImageSyntax、createImageWidget、loadImage 各自的职责与触发顺序。

lectures.title: imageLoader：异步加载、双缓存与路径安全
lectures.topic: 讲解 imageLoader 工具：loadImage 的异步加载与超时保护、双缓存（imageCache 成功结果 + loadingPromises 去重）、resolveImagePath 对相对路径与路径穿越（../）的净化处理，以及为何失败结果不缓存。
learning_goals: 理解双缓存如何避免重复请求与重复渲染
掌握 resolveImagePath 对 data:/http(s) 与相对路径的不同处理及安全净化
看懂失败不缓存、允许重试的设计取舍
lectures.practice_task: 设计一个测试场景：连续两次 loadImage 同一 src，验证第二次命中 imageCache；再对含 ../ 的相对路径调用 resolveImagePath，说明净化后的输出。

lectures.title: linkPlugin：链接渲染、Wiki 链接与 URL 安全
lectures.topic: 讲解 linkPlugin（ViewPlugin）如何渲染标准链接 [text](url) 与 Lezer 不支持的 Wiki 链接 [[target|display]]（用正则全文扫描），跳过代码块，并用 isSafeUrl/sanitizeUrl 拦截 javascript:/vbscript: 等危险协议。
learning_goals: 理解标准链接与 Wiki 链接的两种解析路径（语法树 vs 正则扫描）
掌握 SKIP_PARENT_TYPES 跳过代码块/行内代码的范围收集
看懂 URL 危险协议过滤与 encodeURI 净化的安全实践
minimal_modules: 标准链接 vs Wiki 链接解析
URL 净化与危险协议拦截
lectures.practice_task: 构造三个链接测试用例（含 javascript: 危险协议、普通 http 链接、Wiki 链接），分别说明 parseLinkSyntax/parseWikiLink 与 sanitizeUrl 的处理结果。

units.title: 主题、测试、架构与二次开发

lectures.title: editorTheme：CSS 变量主题与标记动画
lectures.topic: 讲解 editorTheme 如何用 EditorView.theme 定义样式：基于 HSL CSS 变量（--md-heading/--md-bold/--md-link 等，带 fallback）实现可定制主题，以及标记的 max-width/font-size 过渡动画、图片 spinner 与公式淡入动画。
learning_goals: 掌握 EditorView.theme 的对象式样式定义语法
理解 CSS 变量 + fallback 如何让主题可外部定制（含暗色模式由外部覆盖变量）
看懂行内/块级标记用 max-width/font-size 过渡而非 display:none 的动画技巧
lectures.practice_task: 通过覆盖 CSS 变量实现一套暗色主题（修改 --foreground/--background/--primary 等），说明为什么不需要改动 editorTheme 源码即可换肤。

lectures.title: 测试策略：用 Vitest + jsdom 测试 ViewPlugin 与 Widget
lectures.topic: 讲解项目的测试方法：Vitest + jsdom 环境，如何构造 EditorView、用捕获装饰的插件验证 ViewPlugin 行为、mock navigator.clipboard 与 loadImage、以及用 widget.eq 验证重渲染优化。
learning_goals: 掌握在 jsdom 中创建 EditorView 并验证装饰的测试套路
理解如何 mock clipboard 与异步 loadImage 以获得确定性测试
看懂 widget.eq 相等性测试如何对应 CodeMirror 的重渲染优化
lectures.practice_task: 为 renderInlineMarkdown 或 parseLinkSyntax 选一个，参考现有 __tests__ 风格补一个边界用例测试（如空输入、危险协议），运行 npm test 确认通过。

lectures.title: 整体架构与设计取舍
lectures.topic: 基于设计文档回顾整体架构：三种视图模式（reading/live/source）、数据流（用户动作→Transaction→State→装饰→DOM）、Decoration 两种策略的取舍、ViewPlugin vs StateField 的选择、以及性能优化（拖拽跳过重建、KaTeX/图片缓存）。
learning_goals: 掌握整个库从输入到 DOM 的数据流与各层职责
理解 mark+CSS 与 replace+Widget 两种装饰策略的适用场景与取舍
总结 ViewPlugin/StateField/Widget/Facet 各自承担的架构角色
lectures.practice_task: 写一篇 300 字左右的小结：如果要用一句话概括这个库的架构核心，你会怎么说？并指出 shouldShowSource 在其中扮演的

lectures.title: 二次开发：编写自己的 Live Preview 插件
lectures.topic: 综合前述知识，指导读者编写一个自定义 Live Preview 插件：复用 shouldShowSource/checkUpdateAction/WidgetType 与现有工具，从识别语法节点到产出装饰，完整走一遍开发流程。
learning_goals: 掌握自定义插件从需求分析到装饰产出的完整步骤
学会复用 core 机制（shouldShowSource、checkUpdateAction、mouseSelecting）保证与原生体验一致
理解如何在 src/index.ts 导出并在 demo 中验证自定义扩展
lectures.practice_task: 实现一个自定义 Live Preview 插件：把 Markdown 的 ==高亮== 文本用 Decoration.replace 替换成 <mark> 元素，光标进入时显示源码，并复用 shouldShowSource 与 checkUpdateAction；在 demo 中接入验证。

data.head: f1438ab14f4641b761af40ccf764653624c923f1
data.rationale: 学习路线围绕一条主线展开：shouldShowSource 决策函数 + 两种装饰策略（Decoration.mark 配 CSS 隐藏标记 vs Decoration.replace 配 Widget 替换渲染）。第一单元从零开始，讲清项目定位、源码目录、库入口、构建运行 demo 和第一次集成；第二单元铺开 Live Preview 的核心机制（CodeMirror 6 概念、shouldShowSource、Facet/mouseSelecting/checkUpdateAction、livePreviewPlugin、markdownStylePlugin），这是理解一切的基础；第三单元以数学公式为范例引入 WidgetType+Decoration.replace 的渲染模式，并说明行内用 ViewPlugin、块级必须用 StateField 的关键区别；第四单元按"解析↔序列化↔渲染↔可编辑"的顺序讲表格子系统；第五单元把代码块放到专家层，因为它是当前最复杂的模块（auto/toggle/inline 三种交互、Canvas 点击定位、HAST 高亮、源码模式切换）；第六单元讲图片（异步加载+双缓存+路径安全）与链接（URL 净化+Wiki 链接）；最后第七单元回到主题、测试、整体架构取舍与自定义插件开发。依赖关系设计为先核心机制后特性模块，先简单（math/table）后复杂（codeBlock），代码块作为压轴专家内容。

lectures.title: 项目定位与功能总览
lectures.topic: 介绍 codemirror-live-markdown 是什么：一个为 CodeMirror 6 提供 Obsidian 风格 Live Preview 的模块化插件集合，以及它的核心功能、版本演进和模块化设计理念。
learning_goals: 理解 Live Preview（实时预览）与源码模式、阅读模式的区别
掌握项目的模块化、零强制依赖、按需引入的核心理念
了解项目从 v0.1 到 v0.5 的功能演进路线
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 README 的功能矩阵表，列出当前版本支持的全部特性，并用一句话说明每个特性对应的扩展点（core 还是 optional）。

lectures.title: 源码目录结构与库入口
lectures.topic: 讲解 src 目录的组织（core/plugins/widgets/utils/theme）以及 src/index.ts 作为统一导出入口如何把所有扩展、工具、类型汇聚给使用者。
learning_goals: 熟悉 src 下 core/plugins/widgets/utils/theme 五个分层各自的职责
看懂 src/index.ts 如何分类导出（Core / Plugins / Theme / Utils）
理解 peerDependencies 与可选依赖（katex/lowlight）的作用
lectures.practice_task: 在 src/index.ts 中追踪 livePreviewPlugin、mathPlugin、codeBlockField、imageField 分别来自哪个子模块文件，画一张导出关系图。

lectures.title: 构建、测试与运行 demo
lectures.topic: 讲解如何使用 npm scripts 进行开发：tsup 构建（ESM+CJS+dts）、Vitest 测试（jsdom 环境）、以及如何启动 demo 查看真实效果，并介绍 CI 流程。
learning_goals: 掌握 npm run dev/build/test/typecheck/lint 各脚本的作用
理解 tsup 配置如何产出多格式包并 external 掉 CodeMirror 依赖
学会在本地跑起 demo 看到五种编辑器配置
lectures.practice_task: 运行 npm install && npm test 确认测试通过，再进入 demo 目录运行 npm run dev，在浏览器中打开页面确认 5 个编辑器都能渲染。

lectures.title: 快速集成：搭建第一个 Live Preview 编辑器
lectures.topic: 基于 README 的 Quick Start 和 demo/main.ts，讲解如何在任意 CodeMirror 6 编辑器中接入库，重点说明 collapseOnSelectionFacet、mouseSelectingField 与 mousedown/mouseup 派发 setMouseSelecting 的必备接线。
learning_goals: 掌握核心扩展的最小组合（livePreviewPlugin + markdownStylePlugin + editorTheme + facet + mouseSelectingField）
理解为什么必须手动监听 mousedown/mouseup 并派发 setMouseSelecting
学会用 Compartment 在 Live/Source 模式间动态切换
lectures.practice_task: 仿照 demo/main.ts，新建一个最小 HTML 页面，挂载一个 CodeMirror 编辑器，启用 livePreviewPlugin 并正确接线 mouseSelecting，输入 **粗体** 观察标记在光标进入时显隐。

lectures.title: CodeMirror 6 核心概念速览
lectures.topic: 为后续读源码铺垫 CodeMirror 6 的核心概念：EditorState、EditorView、Transaction、Decoration（mark/replace/widget/line）、StateField、ViewPlugin、Facet、Compartment，以及 Lezer 语法树 syntaxTree。
learning_goals: 理解 EditorState 不可变模型与 Transaction 更新机制
区分 ViewPlugin 与 StateField 提供装饰的两种方式
掌握 Decoration 的四种类型（mark/replace/widget/line）及各自用途
了解 syntaxTree 节点迭代如何驱动 Markdown 解析
lectures.practice_task: 阅读设计文档的架构概览章节，写一段话解释：为什么块级装饰（block decoration）必须通过 StateField 而不能通过 ViewPlugin 提供。

lectures.title: shouldShowSource：显示源码还是渲染
lectures.topic: 深入讲解整个 Live Preview 的决策核心函数 shouldShowSource：它依据 collapseOnSelectionFacet 是否启用、mouseSelectingField 是否在拖拽、选区是否与目标区间相交，决定一段 Markdown 是显示源码还是渲染结果。
learning_goals: 读懂 shouldShowSource 的三个判定步骤及其短路逻辑
理解光标/选区与元素区间的相交判定（range.from <= to && range.to >= from）
明白拖拽时返回 false（不显示源码）以避免闪烁的原因
lectures.practice_task: 编写一个独立的小函数测试：给定文档 'Hello **world** test'，构造光标分别在位置 5、10、以及选区 4-12 的 EditorState，断言 shouldShowSource 对区间 (6,15) 的返回值符合预期。

lectures.title: 状态支撑：Facet、mouseSelecting 与 checkUpdateAction
lectures.topic: 讲解支撑 Live Preview 的三块核心状态：collapseOnSelectionFacet（开关）、mouseSelectingField（拖拽状态 StateField + setMouseSelecting Effect）、checkUpdateAction（统一判断 ViewPlugin 何时 rebuild/skip/none）。
learning_goals: 掌握 Facet.define 的 combine 用法与开关语义
理解 StateField + StateEffect 的拖拽状态追踪模式
读懂 checkUpdateAction 如何用 docChanged/viewportChanged/drag/selection 推导更新动作
lectures.practice_task: 在 checkUpdateAction 的基础上，写一个表格说明：面对「文档改变/拖拽中/拖拽刚结束/选区改变/配置重置」五种情况时，函数分别返回什么动作，并解释理由。

lectures.title: livePreviewPlugin：用 CSS 动画隐藏标记
lectures.topic: 讲解 livePreviewPlugin 如何遍历语法树找到标记节点（EmphasisMark/StrikethroughMark/CodeMark/HeaderMark/ListMark/QuoteMark），用 Decoration.mark 套 CSS 类，结合 shouldShowSource 决定是否加 visible 类，实现平滑显隐动画。
learning_goals: 理解标记节点（mark node）与内容节点的区别
掌握用 syntaxTree.iterate 过滤特定 node.name 的写法
看懂 isInsideSkippedParent 如何跳过 FencedCode/CodeBlock 内部的标记
理解为什么用 Decoration.mark+CSS 而非 Decoration.replace 来隐藏标记
lectures.practice_task: 修改（或在本地说明如何修改）livePreviewPlugin，新增对某个未处理的标记类型（如列表项的 '+' 标记）的隐藏，要求复用 shouldShowSource 与 CSS 类切换逻辑。

lectures.title: markdownStylePlugin：为内容节点加样式
lectures.topic: 讲解 markdownStylePlugin 如何遍历语法树为内容节点（ATXHeading1-6、StrongEmphasis、Emphasis、Strikethrough、InlineCode、Link）套样式类（cm-header-1、cm-strong 等），与 livePreviewPlugin 的职责分工，以及标题额外用 Decoration.line 装饰整行。
learning_goals: 理解 styleMap 如何把语法树节点名映射到 CSS 类
掌握 markdownStylePlugin 与 livePreviewPlugin 的关注点分离（内容样式 vs 标记隐藏）
看懂标题同时用 mark 和 line 两种装饰的写法
lectures.practice_task: 参考 styleMap，新增一个样式映射（例如为 Task 列表项 - [ ] 套一个 cm-task 类），并说明 markdownStylePlugin 为什么不需要依赖 shouldShowSource。

units.title: Widget 渲染机制与数学公式

lectures.title: WidgetType 与 Decoration.replace 渲染模式
lectures.topic: 以 mathWidget 为范例，系统讲解 Live Preview 的第二种渲染策略：用 Decoration.replace 把一段 Markdown 替换成 WidgetType.toDOM 生成的真实 DOM，介绍 eq、ignoreEvent、block 等关键点。
learning_goals: 掌握 WidgetType 子类必须实现的 eq/toDOM/ignoreEvent
理解 Decoration.replace({widget, block}) 的用法与 block 装饰限制
明白 eq 为何能避免无谓重渲染
lectures.practice_task: 实现一个最简 WidgetType 子类（如把 ===text=== 替换成带下划线的 <u> 元素），正确实现 eq 与 toDOM，并用 Decoration.replace 应用它。

lectures.title: mathPlugin：行内数学公式
lectures.topic: 讲解 mathPlugin 这个 ViewPlugin 如何识别行内公式（借助 InlineCode 节点且文本形如 `$...$` 的技巧），结合 shouldShowSource 在渲染 Widget 与显示源码（cm-math-source 标记）之间切换。
learning_goals: 理解为什么行内公式复用 InlineCode 节点而非自定义语法
掌握用 checkUpdateAction 驱动 ViewPlugin 更新的写法
看懂渲染态用 Decoration.replace、编辑态用 Decoration.mark 的双模式
lectures.practice_task: 追踪代码：当光标进入一行内公式时，mathPlugin 会产出什么装饰？退出时又产出什么？用表格对照说明。

lectures.title: blockMathField 与 mathCache：块级公式与 KaTeX 缓存
lectures.topic: 讲解块级公式用 StateField（blockMathField）而非 ViewPlugin 的原因，如何识别 ```math 围栏块并逐行加 cm-math-source-block 装饰，以及 mathCache 如何用 Map 缓存 KaTeX 渲染结果提升性能。
learning_goals: 理解块级装饰为何必须用 StateField（ViewPlugin 无法处理 block）
掌握 CodeInfo/CodeText 子节点提取围栏语言与代码文本的方法
看懂 mathCache 的键设计（'inline:src'/'block:src'）与缓存收益
lectures.practice_task: 实现一个 clearMathCache 后的基准对照：在一份含重复公式的文档里，说明首次渲染与缓存命中时 renderMath 的调用路径差异，并解释为何缓存命中能显著降低 KaTeX 开销。

lectures.title: tableParser 与 tableSerializer：表格的解析与序列化
lectures.topic: 讲解纯函数式的表格解析与序列化：parseMarkdownTable 把 GFM 表格文本解析成 TableData（headers/alignments/rows），serializeMarkdownTable 反向序列化，处理对齐、转义管道符、列数补齐。
learning_goals: 掌握 GFM 表格三要素（表头行/分隔行/数据行）的解析规则
看懂转义管道符 \| 的占位替换处理与列数补齐逻辑
lectures.practice_task: 为一个不规整表格（某行单元格数多于表头）写出 parse→serialize 往返的预期输出，并验证序列化结果是否规整对齐。

lectures.title: tableField：只读 GFM 表格渲染
lectures.topic: 讲解 tableField（StateField）如何遍历语法树找 Table 节点，解析表格源码，结合 shouldShowSource 在 TableWidget 渲染与逐行 cm-table-source 源码态之间切换，以及 TableWidget 用 renderInlineMarkdown 渲染单元格内联格式。
learning_goals: 理解 tableField 的更新策略（docChanged/drag/selection 触发重建）
掌握 TableWidget.toDOM 构建 thead/tbody 并套用对齐样式的写法
了解 renderInlineMarkdown 工具如何在单元格内渲染粗体/斜体/行内代码
lectures.practice_task: 说明：当光标进入一个表格时，装饰如何从 TableWidget 切换为逐行 cm-table-source？追踪 buildTableDecorations 的两个分支。

lectures.title: tableEditorPlugin：可编辑表格与 source mode 切换
lectures.topic: 讲解 tableEditorPlugin 的可编辑表格方案：tableSourceModeField 用 setTableSourceMode Effect 跟踪每张表的源码态，TableEditorWidget 用 contenteditable 单元格，编辑后通过 commit 回调→serializeMarkdownTable→view.dispatch 把改动写回文档。
learning_goals: 掌握 setTableSourceMode StateEffect 与 rangesOverlap/addRange/removeRange 区间管理
理解 contenteditable 单元格的 focus/blur/Enter 提交时机
看懂单元格编辑如何经 serialize→dispatch 写回 Markdown 文档
lectures.practice_task: 梳理一次单元格编辑的完整数据流：用户聚焦单元格→输入→失焦，列出每一步触发的回调、产生的 Effect/changes，以及最终文档如何被替换。

lectures.title: codeHighlight：lowlight 集成与懒加载
lectures.topic: 讲解 codeHighlight 工具如何用懒加载方式集成 lowlight：initHighlighter 异步初始化、isHighlighterAvailable 检查、highlightCode 返回 HTML、registerLanguage 注册额外语言，以及未安装 lowlight 时的优雅降级。
learning_goals: 理解 lowlight 模块的懒加载（动态 import）与同步/异步初始化策略
掌握 highlightCode 与 highlightCodeHast 的区别（HTML vs HAST）
看懂语言未注册或 lowlight 不可用时的降级处理
lectures.practice_task: 参照 README，编写一段调用 initHighlighter() 与 registerLanguage 注册一个新语言（如 rust）的代码，并说明在 lowlight 缺失时 highlightCode 会返回什么。

lectures.title: codeBlockField：三种交互模式 auto/toggle/inline
lectures.topic: 讲解 codeBlockField 如何识别 FencedCode 节点、跳过 math 等特殊语言，并支持三种 interaction：auto（光标进入显示源码）、toggle（显式 MD/Code 按钮切换）、inline（保留围栏内代码可原生编辑），以及 codeBlockSourceModeField 跟踪源码态。
learning_goals: 理解 CodeInfo 提取语言、SKIP_LANGUAGES 跳过 math 的机制
掌握三种 interaction 模式的渲染与更新差异（auto 依赖 selection，toggle/inline 不重建）
看懂 setCodeBlockSourceMode Effect 与 codeBlockSourceModeField 的区间映射
lectures.practice_task: 对比 codeBlockField({interaction:'auto'}) 与 codeBlockEditorPlugin()（即 toggle），在文档变化、选区变化、拖拽时各自的 update 是否重建装饰，写一张决策表。

lectures.title: codeBlockWidget：DOM 渲染、复制按钮与点击定位
lectures.topic: 深入 codeBlockWidget 的 toDOM 实现：工具栏（MD/Code/Copy 按钮）、按行渲染带 data-line-index 的代码、ignoreEvent 与 mousedown/mouseup/click 冒泡控制、以及用 Canvas 二分查找精确计算点击落在源码的字符位置。
learning_goals: 掌握代码块 Widget 的 DOM 结构与按行高亮渲染
理解 ignoreEvent 与 stopBubbleForBody 如何控制事件冒泡以兼顾按钮点击与编辑
看懂 measureClickOffset 用 Canvas measureText + 二分查找把点击坐标映射到源码位置
minimal_modules: toDOM 工具栏与按行渲染
lectures.practice_task: 说明 measureClickOffset 在 Canvas 不可用时如何退化为按字号估算字符宽度，并解释为什么需要把点击位置精确映射回源码 pos 才能让光标落在正确字符。

lectures.title: inline 模式：保留 contentDOM 的可编辑高亮
lectures.topic: 讲解 inline 交互模式的特殊性：只替换围栏行而把代码内容留在 contentDOM 内可原生编辑，用 highlightCodeHast 产出 HAST 树再经 hastToMarkDecorations 转成 Decoration.mark 高亮，并用 codeBlockSelectionPlugin 给选区加 cm-codeblock-sel 标记。
learning_goals: 理解 inline 模式为何只替换围栏行、保留代码文本在 contentDOM
掌握 highlightCodeHast + hastToMarkDecorations 把语法树节点转成 mark 装饰的递归遍历
看懂 codeBlockSelectionPlugin 如何用 Decoration.mark 处理行内选区高亮
lectures.practice_task: 对比 inline 模式与 auto 模式：分别说明代码内容是存在于 Widget DOM 还是 contentDOM，以及高亮是通过 innerHTML 还是 Decoration.mark 实现，列出各自优劣。

lectures.title: imageField：图片预览与加载状态
lectures.topic: 讲解 imageField（StateField）如何用正则解析 ![alt](url) 语法，结合 shouldShowSource 在 ImageWidget 渲染与 cm-image-source 源码态之间切换，以及 ImageWidget 的 loading/error 状态与异步加载渲染。
learning_goals: 理解 parseImageSyntax 的正则与 isLocal 判定
掌握 ImageWidget.toDOM 的 loading→loaded/error 状态机
看懂 shouldShowSource 控制图片渲染态与源码态切换
lectures.practice_task: 追踪一张远程图片从被解析到加载完成的完整过程：列出 parseImageSyntax、createImageWidget、loadImage 各自的职责与触发顺序。

lectures.title: imageLoader：异步加载、双缓存与路径安全
lectures.topic: 讲解 imageLoader 工具：loadImage 的异步加载与超时保护、双缓存（imageCache 成功结果 + loadingPromises 去重）、resolveImagePath 对相对路径与路径穿越（../）的净化处理，以及为何失败结果不缓存。
learning_goals: 理解双缓存如何避免重复请求与重复渲染
掌握 resolveImagePath 对 data:/http(s) 与相对路径的不同处理及安全净化
看懂失败不缓存、允许重试的设计取舍
lectures.practice_task: 设计一个测试场景：连续两次 loadImage 同一 src，验证第二次命中 imageCache；再对含 ../ 的相对路径调用 resolveImagePath，说明净化后的输出。

lectures.title: linkPlugin：链接渲染、Wiki 链接与 URL 安全
lectures.topic: 讲解 linkPlugin（ViewPlugin）如何渲染标准链接 [text](url) 与 Lezer 不支持的 Wiki 链接 [[target|display]]（用正则全文扫描），跳过代码块，并用 isSafeUrl/sanitizeUrl 拦截 javascript:/vbscript: 等危险协议。
learning_goals: 理解标准链接与 Wiki 链接的两种解析路径（语法树 vs 正则扫描）
掌握 SKIP_PARENT_TYPES 跳过代码块/行内代码的范围收集
看懂 URL 危险协议过滤与 encodeURI 净化的安全实践
minimal_modules: 标准链接 vs Wiki 链接解析
URL 净化与危险协议拦截
lectures.practice_task: 构造三个链接测试用例（含 javascript: 危险协议、普通 http 链接、Wiki 链接），分别说明 parseLinkSyntax/parseWikiLink 与 sanitizeUrl 的处理结果。

units.title: 主题、测试、架构与二次开发

lectures.title: editorTheme：CSS 变量主题与标记动画
lectures.topic: 讲解 editorTheme 如何用 EditorView.theme 定义样式：基于 HSL CSS 变量（--md-heading/--md-bold/--md-link 等，带 fallback）实现可定制主题，以及标记的 max-width/font-size 过渡动画、图片 spinner 与公式淡入动画。
learning_goals: 掌握 EditorView.theme 的对象式样式定义语法
理解 CSS 变量 + fallback 如何让主题可外部定制（含暗色模式由外部覆盖变量）
看懂行内/块级标记用 max-width/font-size 过渡而非 display:none 的动画技巧
lectures.practice_task: 通过覆盖 CSS 变量实现一套暗色主题（修改 --foreground/--background/--primary 等），说明为什么不需要改动 editorTheme 源码即可换肤。

lectures.title: 测试策略：用 Vitest + jsdom 测试 ViewPlugin 与 Widget
lectures.topic: 讲解项目的测试方法：Vitest + jsdom 环境，如何构造 EditorView、用捕获装饰的插件验证 ViewPlugin 行为、mock navigator.clipboard 与 loadImage、以及用 widget.eq 验证重渲染优化。
learning_goals: 掌握在 jsdom 中创建 EditorView 并验证装饰的测试套路
理解如何 mock clipboard 与异步 loadImage 以获得确定性测试
看懂 widget.eq 相等性测试如何对应 CodeMirror 的重渲染优化
lectures.practice_task: 为 renderInlineMarkdown 或 parseLinkSyntax 选一个，参考现有 __tests__ 风格补一个边界用例测试（如空输入、危险协议），运行 npm test 确认通过。

lectures.title: 整体架构与设计取舍
lectures.topic: 基于设计文档回顾整体架构：三种视图模式（reading/live/source）、数据流（用户动作→Transaction→State→装饰→DOM）、Decoration 两种策略的取舍、ViewPlugin vs StateField 的选择、以及性能优化（拖拽跳过重建、KaTeX/图片缓存）。
learning_goals: 掌握整个库从输入到 DOM 的数据流与各层职责
理解 mark+CSS 与 replace+Widget 两种装饰策略的适用场景与取舍
总结 ViewPlugin/StateField/Widget/Facet 各自承担的架构角色
lectures.practice_task: 写一篇 300 字左右的小结：如果要用一句话概括这个库的架构核心，你会怎么说？并指出 shouldShowSource 在其中扮演的

lectures.title: 二次开发：编写自己的 Live Preview 插件
lectures.topic: 综合前述知识，指导读者编写一个自定义 Live Preview 插件：复用 shouldShowSource/checkUpdateAction/WidgetType 与现有工具，从识别语法节点到产出装饰，完整走一遍开发流程。
learning_goals: 掌握自定义插件从需求分析到装饰产出的完整步骤
学会复用 core 机制（shouldShowSource、checkUpdateAction、mouseSelecting）保证与原生体验一致
理解如何在 src/index.ts 导出并在 demo 中验证自定义扩展
lectures.practice_task: 实现一个自定义 Live Preview 插件：把 Markdown 的 ==高亮== 文本用 Decoration.replace 替换成 <mark> 元素，光标进入时显示源码，并复用 shouldShowSource 与 checkUpdateAction；在 demo 中接入验证。
